args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18) since the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an elevated error rate (0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Rollback verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the rollback and flagging the v2.3.1 regression for root-cause investigation.
